stories.title: Breaking down the 49ers' win against the Rams in Australia
stories.summary: Los Angeles flew in the day before the game, but it was the Niners who walked away with the win.

stories.title: Report: Feds open investigation into Clippers' dealings with Kawhi
stories.summary: A federal investigation has been opened into the Clippers for allegedly circumventing the NBA's salary cap to compensate Kawhi Leonard, The New York Times reported.

stories.title: Shanahan, McVay brush off teams' differing travel plans as factor in game
stories.summary: Though many Niners players applauded the team's decision to travel to Melbourne a week in advance, Kyle Shanahan and Sean McVay said they didn't think the Niners' and Rams' different arrival times factored into San Francisco's 27-7 win.

stories.title: DE Garrett says he's not 100% after dud in Rams' loss to 49ers
stories.summary: Myles Garrett, who went without a tackle in his first game with the Rams, called his performance "the worst version of myself that I've put out there."

stories.title: Rybakina ends Gauff's US Open run, sets up title clash with Sabalenka
stories.summary: Elena Rybakina rallied to take down Coco Gauff 3-6, 6-4, 6-4 on Thursday night to set up a US Open final against two-time defending champion Aryna Sabalenka, whom she will replace atop the rankings next week.
